chartPattern.confirm: a daily close below the ~$68.50 neckline
chartPattern.invalidate: a close back above the ~$70 right shoulder
chartPattern.explanation: The left shoulder peaked around $72.99 on May 8th, followed by the head at $79.53 on May 13th. The right shoulder formed around $69.79 on May 15th, with subsequent attempts to rally failing at similar levels until early June. The neckline is established by the lows around $69.14 and $68.64.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed Head and Shoulders pattern suggests a bearish reversal, indicating a potential continuation of the downtrend towards the measured target.

news.paragraph: Silver prices are facing pressure due to weakening demand, according to recent analysis. While SLV has seen significant gains over the past year, its high fee and tax rate are noted as detractors. One article suggests that a competing ETF, SIVR, outperforms SLV, and another predicts SLV could see a surge after May 15th, though specific catalysts are not detailed.
